Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3cfe245ae5f38110b50feb28aeb97c7a as of 2026-09-02T08:31:27.200Z: {"title":"Shona Dion · Council · chal"} **Filled card. Not published.** Shona Dion · Council · challenger. Scored 2 Sep 2026 against **The Program — A City That Works v1.10 (31 Jul 2026)** using the 12-topic template and Decision 14. **The letter on this card is a dash.** An internal proposal sits at the bottom of the page and is Joa's to apply or reject. Evidence base is the authorized 2026 campaign site (home, My Story, Priorities, 6-ways community page), one dated Instagram campaign post, and the candidate photography site checked as non-policy. Challenger: no 2022–26 City term, so no Record lines and no incumbent haircut. ## Card
Field Value
Name Shona Dion
Office Council
Kind chal (no 2022–26 City term — 2026 plan taken at face value, no record haircut)
Platform URL (2026) [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/) · [Priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities)

Checked by · date Verifier · 2026-09-02
### The five doors (front of the live card) Each door is **said / record / yes / —**: a sourced sentence or a fact. Never a second grade.
Door Measure said / record / yes / — sentence or fact URL date
Tax cap M66 **—** No residential-rate, cap, formula or glide-path position on the site, Priorities, My Story or the dated Instagram post. — —
Downtown order M26 / M27 **—** "community safety" appears once, as one item in a list of crises neighbourhoods should have agency over. No Public Order Team, no bylaw-hours, no unified-command position. Mention, so a dash. The sentence is scored once, on row 53. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/) lastmod 2026-08-30, retrieved 2026-09-02
Housing M6 **said** "As a city we can continue to work with the province to support social housing and cooperative living spaces." No unit target, 3-bedroom share, below-market share or rental-share number. Scored on row 1. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
Household bill M66d **—** Water, sewer, stormwater and the combined household number are not mentioned. AI-data-centre water protection is a different sentence, noted on row 17, not a household bill. — —
Written program — **yes** An authorized campaign site with biography, a Priorities page covering economics, environment and housing, a community-connection page, contact and donation functions, plus current Facebook and Instagram. Written and current. No costed budget, no tax formula, no unit target, no implementation calendar. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
## The 12 topics Column key: **answer** = the mark · **quote or fact** = the verbatim sentence, then context · **URL** · **date** = lastmod, retrieved. A dash is unknown, not a fail. ### 1 · Housing that gets built
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
1 M6 housing supply + composition **Partial 1.0** "As a city we can continue to work with the province to support social housing and cooperative living spaces." · Commits to supporting social and co-op housing. The instrument named is provincial partnership, not a City unit target, composition share, missing-middle rule or zoning path. Context, same page, not scored separately: "Housing is a right, not a commodity"; "Everyone deserves a home to call their own, and space to rest." Co-ops in this sentence are not given a second mark on row 2. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
2 M6b land bank + co-ops — Cooperative living spaces sit inside the sentence already scored on row 1. One sentence, one measure. No City land bank, acquisition fund or co-op financing vehicle. — —
3 M7 permits + AI pre-screening — No permit-time position, no published standard, nothing on AI pre-screening. Opposition to AI data centres is a water-and-employment sentence, noted on row 46, not a permit tool. — —
4 M7b pattern-book housing — Pre-approved designs do not appear. Photography and "art and building" interest is professional background, which the rules exclude. — —
5 M8/M8b 5% vacancy, DCC cuts, suite amnesty — No vacancy target, no DCC position, no suite amnesty. The census-worker observation of subdivided suites is diagnosis, not an amnesty instrument. — —
### 2 · Downtown order
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
6 M26 Public Order Team — No position on unified command, co-location, or a downtown operations desk. "community safety" on the home page is a Mention inside the neighbourhood-agency sentence scored on row 53. — —
7 M26b civilian crisis response — Crisis response and the right-responder question do not appear. — —
8 M27 bylaw hours 6am–10pm — No bylaw-enforcement hours position. — —
9 M28 data-targeted enforcement — No position on targeting chronic disorder drivers with data. — —
10 M33 daytime sheltering bylaws — Sheltering bylaws do not appear. — —
11 M33b drug-use buffer (City: list + bylaw/DPOT + VicPD/CDSA; not City seizure) — Buffer zones and child-focused spaces do not appear. — —
12 M34–M37 encampments, reclaiming spaces, night lighting — Encampments, removal protocol and lighting do not appear. — —
### 3 · Household bill
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
13 M66 tax glide path (capped on the residential rate) — No tax-rate, cap, formula or year-path. "affordability" appears as housing-and-polycrisis language on Priorities, already in the housing door, not as a residential-rate rule. Mention, so a dash. — —
14 M66b/c over-collection refund + debt rule — No over-collection refund, no debt rule, no supermajority override. Fiduciary and budget experience is professional background, which the rules exclude. — —
15 M66d the Household Bill — The combined household number, water rates, sewer and stormwater do not appear. — —
16 M70/M70b provincial downloading ledger — Housing is described as sitting "alongside provincial responsibilities." That is a jurisdiction note, not a downloading ledger, a refusal threshold or a published transfer table. Mention, so a dash. — —
17 M70c CRD cost and the Goldstream plant — The CRD, regional water rates and the filtration plant do not appear. "I will stand up against AI data centres… we as a society need to ensure that our water is protected" is a data-centre water-use sentence, not Goldstream. Not scored here; flagged in working notes. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
18 M71–M73d business, downtown, one mandate not a new office **Partial 1.0** "We can support and promote local businesses that invest directly into our local economy while ensuring that workers are not exploited nor put in danger in the race for profits." · Commits to local-business support and worker-protection conditions. No vacancy target, no Strategic Economic Plan, no downtown mandate, no flagship event. Context, same block, not scored separately: "We can create governance structures that penalize predatory business methods." Context, Instagram 21 Aug 2026, not scored separately: hear from "small business owners." [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
19 M74/M75/M76 capital threshold, short-stay parking (15-min grace; first-hour gated Year 2), permit fees — No 15-minute grace, no first-hour, no capital-approval threshold, no permit-fee schedule. — —
### 4 · Host Nations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
20 M1–M5 Host Nations Foundation. Topic never drops out of the 12. A dash is still allowed on M1–M5. — "I live on the unceded and traditional territories of the Lək̓ʷəŋən (Lekwungen) speaking peoples, known as the Songhees and Xwsepsum (Kosapsum) First Nations." · A land acknowledgement names the Host Nations. No government-to-government table, no procurement target, no place-name programme, no cultural-protocol package, no urban Indigenous liaison. Mention, so a dash in every column. EDI support on the same page is not M1–M5. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/my_story](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/my_story) lastmod 2026-08-18, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 5 · Homelessness and waitlists
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
21 M9/M9b/M64 tenant protections, STR, indoor heat (M9c struck; 26°C gated) **Close 2.0** "Creating tenancy laws that set a standard for the health and safety of tenants can weed out those investors only looking for profits at the expense of basic tenancy rights." · Commits to a tenant-protection instrument. Comparable to M9's tenant-protection half, not the same as a demoviction bylaw or STR licensing, and not a 26°C indoor-heat standard (M9c struck; 26°C gated). Context, same page, not scored separately: "Ensuring tenants have safeguards against negligent landlords is crucial to allow people to live and work in our city"; "We can facilitate the means to enable vulnerable residents to access cooling mechanisms in their homes or shared spaces" (cooling sits in this cluster as M64 indoor heat, and is not moved to climate); lived renoviction fear is background, not a source. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
22 M10 transparent algorithmic waitlists — A neighbouring-municipality senior "has been on a list for better housing for over five years but because she has a roof over her head currently, she is at the bottom." That is a diagnosis of waitlist failure, not a rules-based digital allocation design. Diagnosis without an instrument is a Mention, so a dash. The person is not in Victoria. — —
23 M11 Housing First + STEP throughput — Homelessness, Housing First, unsheltered targets and STEP throughput do not appear. Social-housing support is scored on row 1, not here. — —
### 6 · Families
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
24 M12/M13b/M13c childcare, doctors, youth (M13 school food is \$0 → M13d) — "As a working mother, Shona understands the everyday pressures families face" is lived-experience background, which the rules exclude. Youth and seniors appear as people who should move through the city more equitably, used as context on row 27. Childcare spaces, family-doctor recruitment and the 18–25 cohort are not addressed. Mention, so a dash. — —
25 M13d standing School District 61 agreement — Schools and SD61 do not appear. — —
### 7 · Streets and mobility
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
26 M14/M16/M17/M18 cleanliness and the public realm — Graffiti, pests, sanitation hours and public art do not appear. — —
27 M19/M22/M38/M40–M42b mobility + Vision Zero (M39 30 km/h struck; calming is M38) **Close 2.0** "I support bike lanes." · Agrees with bike lanes, which are a same-instrument slice of this cluster. No Vision Zero audit, no adaptive signals, no named corridor, no calming design (M39 30 km/h is struck). Context, same block, not scored separately: she uses bike lanes and has been knocked off her bike, including while pregnant; "We must continue to make the means of moving through our city more equitable for our youth, seniors and more vulnerable members of our society." [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
28 M20b/M23b walking and transit the City controls — "Victoria is a city of interconnected walkable pathways, bike paths, bus routes and slower roads. This is positive feature of our city." · Describes the existing network. No sidewalk-gap standard, no City-controlled transit-lever list. Mention, so a dash. Bike lanes are scored on row 27. — —
29 M24b/M25b accessibility and public washrooms — The 6-ways page reports that people value accessible, low-sensory and intergenerational spaces. That is a Local Champions finding she is relaying, not a City accessibility audit or a public-washroom commitment. Mentions, so a dash. — —
30 M25 fix roads first — No maintenance backlog, pothole standard or sequencing rule. "slower roads" is a description of the existing network, already noted on row 28. — —
### 8 · Policing and published safety
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
31 M28b business security cost-spreading — Business security costs do not appear. Local-business support is scored on row 18. — —
32 M28d community paramedicine — Paramedicine and call-volume reduction do not appear. — —
33 M29/M29b VicPD funding + regional review (convene-and-publish; no binding other force) — No VicPD funding, Esquimalt or regional-review position. "community safety" is a Mention on the home page, scored on row 53. Labour affiliations are not a source for a policing mark. — —
34 M30 smart LED lights, no surveillance — Streetlighting and the surveillance limit do not appear. Federal "surveillance pricing" on Priorities is grocery pricing, not cameras. — —
35 M31/M31b/M31c/M32 safety dashboard, published enforcement record, crime target — No safety dashboard, no enforcement record, no crime-reduction number. — —
### 9 · Beauty as a public good
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
36 M43–M46b heritage and cultural venues — Heritage standards, street furniture and cultural venues do not appear. The photography/community site is a portfolio, not a heritage programme. — —
37 M45b/c pedestrianisation and the signature project — Walkable pathways are described as an existing positive feature, already noted on row 28. No pedestrianisation programme, no signature-project shortlist, no referendum. Bike lanes are scored on row 27. — —
38 M47–M49 heritage incentives, lighting, parks — Green-space protection is scored on row 49. No heritage incentives, ornamental lighting or parks programme. — —
39 M50/M50b/M51/M52 culture, sport, and the arts funding floor — Food, music, arts and knitting appear as Local Champions findings about how people connect, not as a City arts, sport or funding-floor position. Photography donated to community groups is background. — —
### 10 · A smaller scored Hall
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
40 M15 managed competition — Competitive testing of City services does not appear. "Prioritizing public ownership over private interest" is an economic-philosophy sentence, not a waste-or-streets contracting position. Not inferred as Opposed. Labour roles are professional background and a seat held, which the rules exclude. Flagged in working notes. — —
41 M65 rotating zero-based reviews — No zero-based cycle, no grant test, no three-part test. Managing budgets as a trustee is professional background, not a source. — —
42 M67 quarterly performance dashboard — No KPI set, no cadence, no dashboard. "hearing people and engaging in meaningful dialogue" is tone, and tone is not a source. Constituent-voice language is used as context on rows 51 and 53. — —
43 M68 overhead reduction by attrition — Headcount, attrition and administrative overhead do not appear. — —
44 M69 real-estate rationalisation — City real-estate holdings do not appear. — —
45 M53/M53b/M53c GIS, AI consultation imagery, LIDAR — GIS, consultation imagery and LIDAR do not appear. — —
46 M53d published municipal AI standard — "I will stand up against AI data centres." · That is opposition to data-centre siting for water and jobs, not a published standard for how the City itself uses AI. Not scored as Opposed to M53d. Flagged in working notes. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
47 M54–M57 local-tech procurement, open data, Wi-Fi, EV charging — Procurement, open data, Wi-Fi and EV charging do not appear. — —
### 11 · Climate and trees as operations
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
48 M58/M58b/M64b climate, district energy, seismic **Weak 0.5** "Climate justice is a method to recognize the unequal effects of climate related damage and mitigate those harms in our communities." · Agrees with climate-harm mitigation as a goal. No 50%/2030 target, no Climate Leadership Plan delivery path, no district energy, no seismic. Context, same page, not scored separately: "Climate change is a known reality. The science cannot be disputed." Cooling access is context on row 21, not a second climate mark. The April 2025 union-magazine forest essay is not a 2026 campaign sentence. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
49 M59–M63 trees, mode share, ecosystems, emergency preparedness **Close 2.0** "We can ensure that we are protecting our green spaces and increasing shade canopies to make outside spaces refuges from our warming climate." · Commits to green-space protection and shade-canopy increase. Comparable to the trees/ecosystems half of M59–M63, not the same as a 5,000-tree or 35% canopy target, and nothing on emergency preparedness. Mode share sits inside the bike-lane sentence already scored on row 27. Context, same page, not scored separately: "I support community gardens and the sharing of natural resources." [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) lastmod 2026-08-14, retrieved 2026-09-02
### 12 · Neighbourhoods and integrity
# measure what it is answer quote or fact URL date
50 M77/M78/M78b \$25M referendum threshold, 5-step process, material-change rule — "she knows that real change starts with hearing people and engaging in meaningful dialogue" is a personal method, not a \$25M threshold, a 5-step sequence or a material-change rule. Tone is not a source. Mention, so a dash. — —
51 M79/M79b Integrity Commissioner + 60-day consultation response — No Integrity Commissioner, no MNP implementation tracker, no 60-day response standard. "It is important to hear from those who not just live in the city, but work in the city" (Instagram 21 Aug 2026) is constituent-voice practice, not an integrity office. Mention, so a dash. — —
52 M79c–f lobbyist registry, FOI fee, remuneration — Lobbyist registry, FOI fees, mandate letters and council pay do not appear. — —
53 M80/M80b/M80c neighbourhoods, language access, Local Area Plans **Partial 1.0** "Her goal is to restore that power to communities and uplift the people already doing the work." · Commits to neighbourhood agency as the campaign goal. No grant line she will create or expand, no language-access standard, no Local Area Plan programme. Context, home page, not scored separately: "neighbourhoods deserve real agency in addressing the many crises we are facing, from housing security and affordability to climate resilience and community safety." Context, 6-ways page: Neighbourhood Associations "create a link between the streets and City Hall"; "Check out the Neighbourhood Grants program" points residents to an existing City programme, and is not a 2026 funding commitment. North Jubilee membership is a seat held, not a source. [https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/) lastmod 2026-08-30, retrieved 2026-09-02
54 M82/M82b community surveys, turnout and ballot access — "I believe in civic responsibility and participating in democratic systems" raises participation with no survey, advance-vote or ballot-access instrument. Mention, so a dash. The 6-ways "stay engaged" list is advice to residents, not a City turnout programme. — —
55 M81 Saanich amalgamation (one line, not the whole topic) — Amalgamation does not appear. — —
## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sources read in full:** [campaign home](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/) (sitemap lastmod 30 Aug 2026, retrieved 2026-09-02) · [My Story](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/my_story) (lastmod 18 Aug 2026) · [Priorities](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/priorities) (lastmod 14 Aug 2026) · [6 ways you can make a difference in your community](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/6-ways-you-can-make-a-difference-in-your-community) (lastmod 1 Jun 2026) · [It Takes a Community](https://www.shonadion4victoria.ca/it_takes_a_community) (supporter form, lastmod 2 Jun 2026) · [Instagram campaign post, 21 Aug 2026](https://www.instagram.com/p/DcTm8WHqp7r/) · [photography/community site](https://www.shonadion.ca/) (portfolio; no municipal programme) · contact and donate pages checked for policy text (none). - **Searched and not found as candidate-authored 2026 policy:** VoteMate profile; news interview; questionnaire; campaign X, Bluesky, Threads, TikTok or YouTube. Facebook page [shonadion4victoria](https://www.facebook.com/shonadion4victoria/) exists and is linked from the site; post text was not extractable this pass (page error / login wall). Further Instagram carousels from 24 Aug–1 Sep 2026 are fundraising, Moss Street Market, and donation asks, not additional programme sentences. NationBuilder leftover event pages (`/orientation-session`, `/community-happy-hour`) show New York venues and 2035 dates; treated as theme templates, not 2026 positions. - **Not a source, applied:** 28 years of union membership; MoveUP executive councillor, job steward, Environment and Human Rights committees; Victoria Labour Council recording secretary / table officer; benefit-plan trustee; North Jubilee Neighbourhood Association membership; working parent; photographer; Labour College of Canada certificate; [MoveUP endorsement, 18 Jun 2026](https://moveuptogether.ca/the-latest/moveup-proudly-endorses-richmonds-milly-yee-and-victorias-shona-dion-in-the-upcoming-2026-bc-municipal-elections/) (third-party endorsement); [Worth More Standing, 9 Apr 2025](https://moveuptogether.ca/the-latest/worth-more-standing/) (pre-campaign union magazine, not a 2026 campaign sentence). - **One sentence, one measure — the ledger.** Seven sentences carry the seven scored cells: (1) work with the province to support social housing and cooperative living spaces → row 1. (2) Creating tenancy laws that set a health-and-safety standard → row 21. (3) I support bike lanes → row 27. (4) support and promote local businesses… workers not exploited → row 18. (5) Climate justice is a method to… mitigate those harms → row 48. (6) protecting our green spaces and increasing shade canopies → row 49. (7) Her goal is to restore that power to communities and uplift the people already doing the work → row 53. - **Contested allocations.** Row 21 Close 2.0 uses tenancy laws rather than the cooling sentence, because tenant-protection is the cluster's centre and M9c/26°C is struck-and-gated; cooling is kept as M64 context in that same cell, not moved to climate. Row 27 Close 2.0 for "I support bike lanes" is Agrees + same instrument; it is the most likely mark to be argued down to Partial 1.0 because Vision Zero, signals and calming are absent. Row 1 stays Partial, not Close, because the instrument is provincial partnership rather than a City supply or composition rule; co-ops in that sentence are not reused on row 2. Row 48 Weak is Agrees + neither on climate justice; if read as a Mention it would drop out and n would be 6. Row 53 Partial treats "goal is to restore" as Commits to neighbourhood agency with no City instrument; if read as Agrees it would fall to Weak 0.5. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence:** none. No City office held 2022–26. Challenger rule applied: 2026 plan taken at face value, no haircut for having no record. - **Legal-feasibility FLAG, not a scoring haircut.** Tenancy "laws" are largely provincial (Residential Tenancy Act). Face-test still scores the published 2026 sentence; capacity is noted, not used to mark Opposed or to invent a dash. AI-data-centre siting and water protection are similarly beyond a single councillor acting alone, and were not forced onto M53d or M70c. - **M15 FLAG, not a mark.** "Prioritizing public ownership over private interest" plus labour office-holding could become a managed-competition question later. No direct statement; not inferred as Opposed. - **Never-list:** no Lisnard / Estrosi / Knafo / Musk / Brivael / Poilievre language used as a source or analogy. - **Rows to put to the candidate before publication:** row 1 (City unit/composition target, or provincial partnership only?) · row 21 (City standards-of-maintenance / business-licence conditions, or a provincial tenancy ask? indoor-heat number?) · row 13 (any residential-rate position?) · row 6 (what does "community safety" mean as a City instrument?) · row 40 (public ownership vs competitive testing of City services) · row 53 (Neighbourhood Grants as a 2026 funding commitment, or a pointer to the existing programme?). - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close **11 Sep 2026**, and immediately on any costed platform or questionnaire. Facebook post text should be re-read if the page becomes extractable. - M83 (civic access / public correction, \$0) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. ## INTERNAL proposed letter — not the live letter **PROPOSE: C** · n = 7 · mean 1.36 Sum of scored marks: 2.0 + 2.0 + 2.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 1.0 + 0.5 = **9.5** across **7** scored cells. Mean **1.357**, band **C** (1.25–1.49). C is already one of the five live letters, so no mapping is needed. **This is a proposal, not the live letter.** The card above shows **—**. The live letter waits for Joa's click and compute must not overwrite it. Alignment compute APPLIED for Dion stays **—** unless Joa clicks. **What the proposal is measuring.** Not hostility to the Program — she is not Opposed on a single cell — but distance from it plus a thin denominator. Three Closes (tenancy, bike lanes, shade canopies) sit next to three Partials (social/co-op housing via the province, local business, neighbourhood agency) and one Weak (climate justice with no target). Forty-eight cells are dashes because she has not spoken to them with an instrument, not because she failed them. **Fragility.** Drop the M58 Weak and the mean is 1.50 (C+ → **C**). Argue bike lanes down to Partial and the mean is 1.21 (C− → **C**). Raise M6 to Close and the mean is 1.50 (C+ → **C**). The live set stays C across those three arguments. A single costed fiscal or downtown-order section is what would move the doors, not the letter, until n grows.
